Availability:
- Weekdays: 7–9 a.m.
- Weekends: 8 a.m.–12 p.m.
- Wants 1 rest day/week.

Requested frequency:
- Yoga: 2×/week, 45 min
- Cycling: 1×/week, 2 hr
- Soccer: 1×/week, 1.5 hr
- Triathlon: 3×/week, varying duration, prioritized on weekends.

Goals/fitness:
- Sprint triathlon: June 24.
- Recent charity 5K PB: 26:30 (earlier note said 27:45; use latest 26:30).
- Intermediate in yoga/cycling, beginner in swimming, advanced in running.
- Interested in periodization, progressive overload, warmups/cooldowns, recovery, and workload adjustments.

10K goal/training:
- 10K in about 12 weeks; goal under 55 minutes.
- Currently runs 3×/week: one weekend long run and two weekday shorter runs.
- Average pace reported around 9:30/mile.
- Prefers morning runs; available any day.
- No injuries; comfortable with speed work and hill repeats.
- A prior 12-week plan was increased in intensity/volume based on the 5K: weeks 1–4 base with long run 6–7 miles at 9:00–9:15/mile, shorter runs 3–4 miles at 8:45–9:00; weeks 5–6 6–8×800m at 8:15–8:30 with 400m active recovery; weeks 7–8 6–8×400m hill repeats with 200m recovery; weeks 9–10 3–4 miles at 8:30–8:45; weeks 11–12 taper, reducing volume 20–30%. Include strength once weekly, warmup/cooldown, recovery, and avoid assuming the aggressive paces are automatically appropriate. Listen to body and adjust.

Saturday cycling:
- Wants a 20-mile, low-traffic route in Oakdale, avoiding downtown and highways, incorporating the familiar river bike trail; generally flat with small hills.
